description: Read-only listing of filed declarations and payments, with constancia PDF download
writesNothing: The network path uses the visor's own accion=lista, ConsultaDeclaracion.jsp pagination, accion=validar_constanciaNP and accion=obtener_constanciaNP requests. Nothing files, pays or amends. The only write is the PDF the operator asked for.

auth.session: Existing SOL session from sunat-cli login; the ww1 cookie is minted by the menu hop, so the servlet is never opened cold
auth.credentials: Clave SOL stays in the OS keychain or environment and is never printed

list.description: List declarations and NPS payments presented in a date range

flags.--hasta: DD/MM/YYYY, default today; SUNAT caps the window at six months
flags.--formulario: Client-side filter by form code (0601, 0621, 1663…); a leading zero is added when omitted
flags.--periodo: Client-side filter by tax period YYYYMM (annual returns use YYYY13)

constancia.description: Download the constancia de presentación PDF of one filing

flags.--formulario: Form code of that filing; required because SUNAT keys the constancia by (numOrden, codFor)
flags.--out: Output path, default constancia-<form>-<numOrden>.pdf in the working directory, mode 0600

itemFields.fechaPresentacion: Presentation or payment date exactly as SUNAT prints it, DD/MM/YYYY
itemFields.periodo: Tax period YYYYMM as printed; annual returns use YYYY13
itemFields.descripcion: SUNAT's own label for the form
itemFields.numOrden: Número de orden printed on the constancia
itemFields.kind: declaracion (links to a constancia) or pago (NPS boleta 1663)
itemFields.numPresentacion: pago rows only: the presentation the boleta settles

boundaries.annualReturns: 0709/0710 are listed but their constancia uses a different servlet and is not downloaded
boundaries.pagination: reads result pages up to a 100-page bound; repeated results, inconsistent pagination or later-page failures are errors, not partial success; live multi-page behavior is unverified
